author.name: Efficiency Emilia
author.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: We need to cut the overhead on the weekly retraining cycle. The current cost of running a full formal review on every model iteration is bleeding our margin on the promotion weeks. I am willing to accept a gap in the training pipeline where no formal sign off exists, provided the final deployment still passes the strict compliance check. If we automate the registry for traceability, we save the hours we currently spend on manual logging. That saved time funds the one manual review we cannot drop. We trade the cost of a governed training step for the speed of getting a new model live before the next leaflet deadline.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states a willingness to accept a gap in formal sign-off and trade the cost of a governed training step for the speed of deployment.
